title: Zeus Juice Mortals - Double Dragon 100ml shortfill E-Liquid
description: Double Dragon from Zeus Juice’s Mortals collection is a powerful all-day flavour that’s ideal for fruit lovers. Rich, fragrant Dragon Fruit makes for a lusciously sweet base, with raspberry adding a delightfully tangy note. A layer of bracing menthol on the exhale makes this e-liquid as refreshing as it is delicious. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vaping mods and sub-ohm tanks .
